extracted.intended_audience: IP Australia examiners and IP professionals (including patent examiners)
extracted.subtask_description: Official guidance describing the purpose and contents of IP Australia examination manuals used to examine and decide on IP applications (patents, trade marks, designs, plant breeder's rights). Explains that manuals provide procedural reference, legislative interpretation and application guidance for examiners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination manuals define official procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: The examination manuals define the official procedures we use to examine applications and help our examiners make consistent decisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manuscripts are used by examiners as the official procedural reference; they are intended to ensure consistency in decision-making across examiners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference guide: Identifying relevant legislation
rubrics_metrics.description: The manuals provide a reference guide for identifying relevant legislation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to locate and identify which statutory provisions apply to a particular application or action.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference guide: Interpreting and applying the legislation
rubrics_metrics.description: The manuals provide a reference guide for interpreting and applying the legislation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance supports consistent interpretation and application of statutory provisions during examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Not a user guide for applicants
rubrics_metrics.description: The manuals aren't a user guide for completing an application for a new IP right.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended primarily for examiners; applicants should not rely on the manuals as step-by-step application filing instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trade marks manual — practice and procedure for filing, examining and registering a trade mark
rubrics_metrics.description: The trade marks manual helps our trade marks examiners: Get information on practice and procedure for filing, examining and registering a trade mark.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manual available online for free; intended to guide examiner practice on filing, examination and registration processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trade marks manual — procedure for searching and examining trade mark applications and related actions
rubrics_metrics.description: The trade marks manual helps our trade marks examiners: Apply our procedure for searching and examining trade mark applications and related actions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the search/examination workflow and how to handle related procedural actions for trade marks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trade marks manual — implement Trade Marks Act 1995 provisions
rubrics_metrics.description: The trade marks manual helps our trade marks examiners: Implement the provisions and regulations of the Trade Marks Act 1995.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains how the Trade Marks Act 1995 and its regulations are to be given effect in examination practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patents manual — practice and procedure for filing, examining and registering a patent
rubrics_metrics.description: The manual helps our patent examiners: Get information on practice and procedure for filing, examining and registering a patent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Patents Manual is an examiner reference for patent filing, prosecution, examination and grant processes; accessible online for free.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patents manual — procedure for searching and examining national and international patent applications and related actions
rubrics_metrics.description: The manual helps our patent examiners: Apply our procedure for searching and examining national and international patent applications and related actions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers search strategies, examination steps, handling of international (e.g., PCT/national phase) matters and related procedural actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patents manual — implement Patents Act 1990 provisions
rubrics_metrics.description: The manual helps our patent examiners: Implement the provisions and regulations of the Patents Act 1990.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on interpreting and applying provisions of the Patents Act 1990 and its regulations during examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Designs manual — practice and procedure for applying, examining and registering a design right
rubrics_metrics.description: The designs manual helps our design rights examiners: Get information on practice and procedure for applying, examining and registering a design right.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examiner reference for procedures specific to design right applications; manual accessible online for free.

rubrics_metrics.name: Designs manual — procedure for searching and examining design right applications and related actions
rubrics_metrics.description: The designs manual helps our design rights examiners: Apply our procedure for searching and examining design right applications and related actions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the examination/search workflow and handling of related procedural matters for design rights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Designs manual — implement Designs Act 2003 provisions
rubrics_metrics.description: The designs manual helps our design rights examiners: Implement the provisions and regulations of the Designs Act 2003.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains how to apply the Designs Act 2003 and its regulations in examination practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plant breeder's rights manual — practices and procedures for PBR applications, examination and registration
rubrics_metrics.description: The manual helps our plant breeder's right (PBR) examiners: Find information on practices and procedures relating to aspects of application, examination and registration of a PBR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examiner guidance covering PBR-specific application and examination practices; available online.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plant breeder's rights manual — procedure for searching and examining PBR applications and related actions
rubrics_metrics.description: The manual helps our PBR examiners: Apply our procedure for searching and examining PBR applications and related actions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets out the PBR search and examination procedures and how to handle related procedural actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plant breeder's rights manual — implement Plant Breeder's Rights Act 1994 provisions
rubrics_metrics.description: The manual helps our PBR examiners: Implement the provisions and regulations of the Plant Breeder's Rights Act 1994.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on interpreting and applying the Plant Breeder's Rights Act 1994 and associated regulations in examination.
